paper.title: DINOv2 ViT-g/14 pretraining on LVD-142M (Section 4-5, Appendix)

note: Most values (multi-crop 2x224 + 8x98, Sinkhorn-Knopp teacher centring, KoLeo weight 0.1, wd 0.04->0.2, teacher temperature 0.04->0.07, mask ratio 0.1-0.5) follow Section 4 and the public training config as best recalled; LR, warmup length, prototype counts, head sizes, and momentum start should be checked against the paper's Appendix before running. The final high-resolution (518 px) adaptation phase and distillation into smaller models are not configured. LVD-142M is not public; ImageNet-22k is a possible substitute. The train loop uses synthetic images.
